items.title: Abe Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: He used to play the lead with Glenn Miller?

ctx.x: He used to play the lead with Glenn Miller? And we were close buddies. And his son went into recording. So I spoke to his son and said, “Can you fix up this thing? It’s been recorded” this one “it was recorded on a homestyle thing, a very good recorder. Can you do something with the recording to clear it up, and maybe take out a couple of bass choruses?” And he has one of these digital things. It’s a very, it’s like his office, let’s say his table, is just about this big. It’s not too big. But all he does was…
